$comment: The one set of versions an agent machine runs together. buzz-acp (Buzz's headless harness, from the block/buzz release bundle) speaks one ACP protocol, and the npm adapters must speak it too: a newer adapter's SDK rejected buzz-acp 0.5.30's initialize (protocolVersion 2 with clientInfo; SDK 2.0.1+ wants info). machine/setup.sh carries these values as shell variables; scripts/check-machine-pins.mjs (in npm run check) fails when setup.sh, its comments or machine/tests disagree with this file. To move any of them, move them together here and in setup.sh, and check the initialize handshake on a machine first.

harness.name: buzz-acp
harness.source: block/buzz release bundle, vendored by hand on each machine
